svg.title: How /audit runs: a skill that forks into a read-only agent
svg.desc: You type a command, a skill supplies the procedure, a read-only agent runs it in its own context, and a drift table comes back. Two cards below open the skill and the agent. Every box can be clicked for more, and two buttons ask for a real run or the next level down.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Show me what typing /audit starts, step by step.')
g.title: A slash command that loads the audit skill

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Show me the audit skill procedure in full.')
g.title: Instructions loaded into the fork, not into this chat

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Show me the auditor agent tool list and why each tool is allowed.')
g.title: Its own context window, read-only tools

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Show me an example drift table from an audit run and how to read it.')
g.title: One row per claim: what the doc says, what is live, which wins

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Show me the audit skill file and what each line of its header does.')
g.text: reads the changelog and the docs
g.title: Open the skill file

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Show me the auditor agent definition and what it is not allowed to do.')
g.text: no Agent, so it cannot fan out
g.title: Open the agent definition

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Run /audit on this project and walk me through what each step did.')
g.text: Walk me through a real run ↗

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Show me the next level down: what the auditor agent does between reading and returning the table.')
